data.name: Dragan
data.gender_notes: Dragan is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dragan is a Slavic name that means 'little dragon'. This name may be given to a child born during the dragon festival or to one who is believed to be strong and brave, like a dragon. The name Dragan carries the meaning “Little dragon” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dragan usually hope their child will grow to embody little dragon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dragan belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little dragon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dragan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: דרגן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דרגן הוא שם שמקורו כנראה מהמילה הסלאבית 'דרג', שמשמעותה לגרור או למשוך. אין לו קשר ישיר לשפה העברית או לתנך, אך הוא עשוי להיות קשור למושגים של משיכה או גרירה ברמה הרוחנית, כמו משיכת האדם אל האל או גרירת הנפש אחרי הרצון האלוהי.

in_greek.name: Ντράγκαν
in_greek.meaning: Ντράγκαν σημαίνει αυτό που τραβάει ή σύρει
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Ντράγκαν είναι όνομα που πιθανόν προέρχεται από τη σλαβική λέξη 'drag', που σημαίνει να τραβάω ή να σύρω. Αν και δεν έχει άμεση σύνδεση με την ελληνική γλώσσα ή την Καινή Διαθήκη, μπορεί να συσχετιστεί με έννοιες έλξης ή πρότασης σε πνευματικό επίπεδο, όπως η έλξη του ανθρώπου προς τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Dragan
in_latin.meaning: Dragan means one who draws or pulls
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Dragan likely originates from the Slavic word 'drag', meaning to draw or pull. Although it does not have a direct connection to Latin or early Christian church texts, it may relate to spiritual concepts of drawing or pulling towards divine will or salvation.

in_english.name: Dragan
in_english.meaning: Dragan means beloved or dear one who draws or pulls
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dragan is believed to originate from Slavic roots, specifically from the word 'drag', meaning to draw or pull. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, its meaning can be spiritually significant, suggesting one who is drawn to God or pulls others towards spiritual growth. Historically, it has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing a person of spiritual significance or a leader who guides others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dragan is deeply rooted in Slavic tradition and mythology, as dragons were believed to be powerful and wise creatures capable of bringing good fortune. Naming a child Dragan was a way of bestowing upon them these desirable traits and ensuring their protection. This name has been passed down through generations, preserving the rich cultural heritage of Slavic folklore.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Dragan also holds spiritual significance, as it represents the power and strength of God. Some Christians believe that the name was given to early warriors and knights to remind them of the power and protection of their Creator. Others see it as a reminder of the dragon symbolism in the Bible, which can represent both evil and good. Ultimately, the name Dragan stands as a reminder of the spiritual power and strength found within us all.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dragan, meaning "little dragon" in Slavic languages, can symbolize the inner strength and courage within us, representing our ability to face challenges and overcome obstacles, just as a dragon slays its adversaries. In Christianity, it can also signify the spiritual battle against evil and the fire of the Holy Spirit within us.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dragan was a Serbian prince in the 13th century. The name Dragan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

It is also a common name in Bulgaria and Romania.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Dragan remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
